summary: The script inventory plugin runs an executable that returns inventory JSON, accepting --list and --host (used only without _meta); it doesn't cache, and since 2.19 directory sources no longer ignore .ini files by default.
questions: What arguments must a dynamic inventory script support?
How do I avoid Ansible calling my inventory script once per host?
Does Ansible cache inventory script results?
Where did the old contrib inventory scripts go?

answer_card.title: script inventory plugin
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.script` runs an executable that returns inventory JSON. The script must accept `--list` and `--host <hostname>`. `--host` is only called if the output has **no `_meta`** key, so include `_meta.hostvars` to avoid one extra call per host.

- Enabled by default; results aren't cached (scripts handle their own caching).
- Old bundled scripts live at https://github.com/ansible-community/contrib-scripts/.
- Since 2.19, a directory inventory source no longer ignores `.ini` files by default (configurable).
